description: Create a user profile search on a social media platform. Polls until the search is complete and returns the full results. Oversized responses are truncated (truncated: true) — read the complete post list in pages with get_user_search_posts (offset, limit, fields=lean). A status of results_pending means the search succeeded but results are still being written; fetch them with get_user_search.

query.description: Username or profile URL to search

name: user_search
